blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Egocentric hand motion provides physical motion supervision for dexterous manipulation and vision-language-action pretraining. Reliable use of this supervision requires accurate and temporally coherent 4D hand reconstruction in metric world space. Existing methods typically lift framewise estimates produced under weak perspective into world coordinates. By ignoring joint-dependent depth variation at close range, this approximation couples errors in translation, orientation, and articulation that persist after world lifting and worsen under occlusion. We present MetricHand, a geometry-aware flow matching framework for 4D hand reconstruction in metric world space. MetricHand encodes depth priors from hand-object interaction regions into joint-associated representations that preserve local spatial structure and metric scale. Fused with visual features, this geometry guides coarse metric estimation and conditions every step of temporal generation. The model jointly recovers world-space translation, global orientation, MANO articulation, and shape, while structural priors and temporal context support estimation under partial occlusion. MetricHand reduces camera-space MPJPE by 49.3% and 52.9%, absolute world-space MPJPE by 28.7% and 21.7%, and wrist localization error by 48.5% and 37.9% relative to HaWoR, respectively. World-space acceleration error decreases by 44.2% and 64.3%, demonstrating improved temporal fidelity alongside more accurate absolute localization.
blocks.zh: 以Egocentral手动提供物理运动监督,以进行可调和的操纵和视觉语言动作预训. 可靠地使用这种监督要求准确和在时间上一致的四维手在平坦的世界空间重建。 现有方法一般是抬高从弱视角到世界坐标的帧估计。 这种近似夫妇在翻译、取向和表达方面的误差, 在世界升起后, 我们介绍MetricHand,一个几何-认识流匹配框架,用于在公尺世界空间进行4D手重建. MetricHand将从手对象相互作用区域到联合关联的表示法的深度前作编码,以保持局部空间结构和度量尺度. 这种几何学方法以视觉特征为迷惑,指导了粗糙的度量估计和时间生成的每一步条件。 该模型共同恢复了世界-空间翻译、全球取向、MANO表达和形状,而结构前科和时间背景则支持部分隔离下的估算。 MetricHand将相机空间MPJPE分别减少49.3%和52.9%,绝对世界空间MPJPE分别减少28.7%和21.7%,与HaWOR相比,手腕本地化误差分别减少48.5%和37.9%. 世界空间加速误差减少了44.2%和64.3%,表明在更精确的绝对本地化的同时,时间忠贞性有所提高。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Hand motion lies at the center of how humans interact with the physical world. In egocentric video, wrist position and orientation specify end-effector targets, while local hand pose defines the articulated configuration that can be transferred to a robot hand through retargeting. These states turn human manipulation videos into scalable physical motion supervision for dexterous manipulation learning and vision-language-action (VLA) pretraining ( Kareer et al., 2025 ; Hoque et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) . Localization errors can shift hand–object interaction targets, and temporal jitter can propagate into generated trajectories. These applications therefore require accurate and temporally coherent 4D hand motion in a common world coordinate system with metric scale.
blocks.zh: 手动位于人类如何与物理世界互动的中心. 在以自我为中心的视频中,手腕位置和方向指定了最终效果目标,而局部手姿则定义了通过重定向可以转移给机器人手的清晰配置. 这些州将人操控视频转化为可伸缩的物理运动监督,用于对人操控的学习和视觉语言动作(VLA)预训(Kareer等人,2025年;Hoque等人,2026年;Yang等人,2025年). 本地化错误可以转换手-对象交互目标,而时间焦点可以传播到生成的轨迹中. 因此,这些应用要求在一个具有度量尺度的共同世界协调系统中准确和在时间上一致的4D手动。

blocks.en: Existing egocentric 4D hand reconstruction commonly combines two stages. Image-based methods such as HaMeR and WiLoR recover detailed hand observations and visual features from individual frames ( Pavlakos et al., 2024 ; Potamias et al., 2025 ) . Temporal methods such as HaWoR and HandFlow combine these estimates with camera motion to reconstruct world-space trajectories ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) . These approaches improve temporal consistency under moving cameras, but they still depend on the image frontend to establish the geometric state of the hand in each frame. When that estimate is biased or the hand is occluded, temporal processing must recover motion from incomplete and potentially distorted evidence.
blocks.zh: 现有的以自我为中心的4D手重建通常结合两个阶段. 基于图像的方法如HaMeR和WiLOR从单个帧中恢复详细的手观测和视觉特征(Pavlakos等人,2024年;Potamias等人,2025年). HaWOR和HandFlow等时态方法将这些估计与相机运动结合起来,重建世界空间轨迹(张等人,2025年;徐等人,2026年). 这些方法提高了移动相机下的时间一致性,但它们仍然依赖于图像前端来确定每个帧中手的几何状态. 当这种估计有偏颇或手被占用时,时间处理必须从不完整和可能扭曲的证据中恢复运动。

blocks.en: Metric hand reconstruction requires resolving the depth ambiguity left by weak-perspective estimates and camera-normalized rays. HandFlow ( Xu et al., 2026 ) conditions flow matching on visual features and skeletal rays, with detection confidence controlling observation strength. StableHand ( Zeng et al., 2026 ) uses predicted observation quality to adapt the flow path and initialization, alongside hand, camera, and scene-geometry conditions. Our focus is the spatial organization of geometric evidence: associating metric depth and nearby hand–object surfaces with individual joints so that the generator can use these cues for both placement and articulation.
blocks.zh: 度量手重建需要解决弱视估计和相机正常射线留下的深度模糊. HandFlow(Xu等人,2026年)在视觉特征和骨骼射线上的条件流量匹配,具有检测信心控制观测强度. StableHand(Zeng等人,2026年)利用预测的观测质量来适应流道和初始化,同时配合手,相机,场景几何条件. 我们的焦点是几何证据的空间组织:将测量深度和附近的手-物体表面与单个关节连接起来,以便发电机能够利用这些提示进行定位和表达。

blocks.en: Our key insight is that a topology-aware representation of hand–object interaction (HOI) geometry can serve as a shared condition throughout 4D hand reconstruction. Local surface structure provides cues for recovering hand articulation under occlusion, while metric depth guides hand localization in world coordinates. Integrating this geometric evidence with temporal memory further supports motion consistency across frames and trajectory continuity across windows. Based on this insight, MetricHand fuses RGB and estimated depth for coarse metric hand estimation, then samples appearance and surface geometry around 21 projected joint anchors. Quality weighting and temporal memory organize these features across windows, and the resulting conditions guide every flow update to jointly recover world-space translation, global orientation, articulation, and shape. Our geometry-conditioning ablations show that maintaining this evidence throughout generation improves reconstruction over using depth only for coarse estimation or supplying geometry only at the first flow step (Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们的关键洞察力是,对手-物体相互作用(HOI)几何的地形认识能成为整个4D手重建的共同条件。 局部地表结构为恢复闭塞下的手伸缩提供了提示,而度量深度指南则为世界坐标的本地化提供了提示。 将这种几何证据与时间内存结合,进一步支持跨帧的运动一致性和跨窗口的轨迹连续性. 基于这种洞察力,MetricHand将RGB和粗度度量手估计的估计深度,然后在21个预测联合锚地上对外观和表面几何进行取样。 质量权重和时间记忆将这些特征组织在窗口之间,由此产生的条件指导每一次流更新,共同恢复世界空间翻译,全球方向,表达和形状. 我们的几何校准显示,在一代人的时间里保持这些证据有助于重建,而不是仅仅为了粗糙的估计而使用深度,或者仅仅在第一流阶段提供几何(表3)。

blocks.en: Under a shared protocol on HOT3D and ARCTIC, the evaluated configuration achieves the lowest wrist localization error and absolute camera- and world-space joint errors among the reevaluated methods. Relative to HaWoR, absolute world-space MPJPE decreases by 28.7% and 21.7%, and world-space acceleration error by 44.2% and 64.3%, respectively. These results demonstrate improvements in absolute localization and motion fidelity (Fig. 1 ). Component and condition ablations assess geometric representation, flow generation, and temporal memory.
blocks.zh: 在HOT3D和ARCTIC共享协议下,被评价的配置在重新评价的方法中实现了手腕定位最小的错误和绝对相机和世界空间联合错误. 相对于HaWOR,绝对世界空间MPJPE分别下降了28.7%和21.7%,世界空间加速误差分别下降了44.2%和64.3%. 这些结果表明,在绝对本地化和运动忠贞性方面有所改进(图1)。 组件和条件模拟评估几何表达、流源生成和时间记忆。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: MANO represents hand shape and articulation with a differentiable parametric mesh ( Romero et al., 2017 ) . Transformer-based models such as HaMeR and WiLoR recover detailed hands from images ( Pavlakos et al., 2024 ; Potamias et al., 2025 ) ; Hamba and HandOS explore alternative spatial reasoning and localization architectures ( Dong et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) . These models provide visual features and articulation priors. Recovering metric motion additionally requires geometric evidence that connects the reconstructed pose to its physical placement.
blocks.zh: MANO代表手形,用不同的参数网格(Romero等人,2017年)来表达. 基于变形器的模型,如HaMeR和WiLOR从图像中回收详细的手(Pavlakos等人,2024年;Potamias等人,2025年);Hamba和HandOS探索替代空间推理和本地化架构(Dong等人,2024年;Chen等人,2025年). 这些模型提供了视觉特征和表达前科. 恢复度量运动还需要几何证据,将重建的姿势与其实际位置联系起来。

blocks.en: Temporal methods combine image evidence with motion priors to reconstruct hand trajectories. HMP learns a hand-motion prior ( Duran et al., 2024 ) , while Dyn-HaMR and HaWoR recover motion under moving cameras ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) . ViDiHand adapts video-diffusion representations for hand reconstruction ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . ACE-Ego-Hand uses a deterministic clean-latent encoder and a bidirectional spatiotemporal decoder to recover bimanual trajectories under occlusion and out-of-sight gaps ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . MINT jointly predicts camera motion, field of view, camera-frame hand states, and observability from a shared video representation, using large-scale pipeline supervision ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) . HandFlow formulates hand recovery with flow matching and confidence-aware observation conditioning ( Xu et al., 2026 ; Lipman et al., 2023 ) . Our focus is the explicit geometric evidence supplied to temporal generation: topology-aware sampling associates HOI appearance, metric depth, and local surface structure with hand joints, and the resulting conditions remain available throughout the flow process.
blocks.zh: 时间学方法将图像证据和运动前身结合起来,重建手轨. HMP学习手动前置(Duran等人,2024年),而Dyn-HAMR和HAWOR则在移动相机下恢复运动(Yu等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2025年). ViDiHand为手部重建改编视频散射表示(Wang等人,2026年). ACE-Ego-Hand使用定型的清洁纬度编码器和双向振荡解码器在闭塞和视差下恢复双动轨迹(Liu等人,2026年). MINT联合预测了相机运动,视野,镜头框手态,以及使用大规模管道监听的共享视频表现的可观察性(Zhu等人,2026年). HandFlow 配以流量匹配和信心感知观测条件(徐等人,2026年;Lipman等人,2023年)进行手部回收. 我们的重点是向时间生成提供明确的几何证据:地形-认识取样与HOI外观、度量深度和手动关节的局部表面结构相关,由此产生的条件在整个流动过程中仍然可用。

blocks.en: Monocular geometry models such as Metric3D, Metric3D v2, and MoGe-2 recover depth and metric-scale cues from a single image ( Yin et al., 2023 ; Hu et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) . Their spatial predictions complement the appearance features of a normalized hand crop. BLADE uses depth to address close-range perspective distortion in body reconstruction ( Wang et al., 2025b ) . For articulated hand motion, depth provides both absolute placement cues and the local layout of the interaction region. We fuse this evidence with RGB features, sample it around hand joints, and preserve it across time as a shared condition for localization and temporally coherent pose estimation. Camera-motion estimation supplies the reference needed to express this geometry in world coordinates ( Teed and Deng, 2021 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: Metric3D,Metric3D v2等单体几何模型和MoGe-2从单一图像中恢复深度和度量级提示(Yin等人,2023年;Hu等人,2024年;Wang等人,2025年a). 它们的空间预测补充了正常的手作物的外观特征. BLADE利用深度解决身体重建中的近距离视角扭曲问题(Wang等人,2025b.). 对于清晰的手动,深度既提供了绝对位置提示,也提供了互动区域的地方布局. 我们把这种证据与RGB的特征结合起来,在手关节周围进行取样,并将它作为本地化和时间一致性的共同条件加以长期保存。 相机运动估计提供了在世界坐标中表达这种几何特征所需的参考(Teed and Deng, 2021; Zhang等人, 2025).

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: MetricHand uses interaction geometry to connect metric hand placement with temporal pose recovery (Fig. 2 ). RGB features and depth priors first produce coarse hand estimates, which are expressed in a metric world frame using the estimated camera trajectory (Sec. 3.2 ). Topology-aware sampling then gathers appearance and surface geometry around the projected hand joints. Observation quality and cross-window memory organize this evidence into joint-associated conditions (Sec. 3.3 ). A conditional flow model reads these conditions at every integration step to jointly recover world-space translation, global orientation, articulation, and shape (Sec. 3.4 ).
blocks.zh: MetricHand使用交互几何将度量手放置与时间姿势恢复联系起来(图2 )。 RGB的特征和深度前缀首先产生粗手估计,这些估计用估计的相机轨迹(Sec. 3.2 )用一个测量世界框架表示. 地形学-认识取样然后在预测的手关节周围收集外观和表面几何。 观测质量和跨窗口内存将这种证据组织成联合关联的条件(第3.3节). 有条件的流动模式在每一个整合步骤上都读到这些条件,以便共同恢复世界空间翻译、全球定向、表达和形状(第3.4条)。

blocks.en: 3.2 Geometry-Aware Hand Representation
blocks.zh: 3.2 几何-智能手表

blocks.en: Following image-based hand reconstruction ( Pavlakos et al., 2024 ; Potamias et al., 2025 ) , a trainable WiLoR-initialized encoder extracts hand–object appearance features F I F^{I} . A frozen monocular geometry model supplies full-frame metric depth ( Hu et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) , and frozen DROID-SLAM estimates relative camera motion ( Teed and Deng, 2021 ) . Depth is aligned to each hand crop with the RGB transform. RGB–D fusion, Temporal MANO, and the Metric Head are trained jointly, while the depth and SLAM networks remain fixed.
blocks.zh: 遵循基于图像的手重建 (Pavlakos等人,2024年;Potamias等人,2025年),一种可训练的WiLOR-初始化编码器提取手-对象外观特征F I F^{I}. 冷冻的单体几何模型提供全帧的测量深度(Hu等人,2024年;Wang等人,2025a),冷冻的DROID-SLAM估计相对相机运动(Teed and Deng,2021年). 深度与RGB变换后的每一手裁剪一致. RGB–D聚变,Temporal MANO,以及Metric Head都是联合训练的,而深度和SAMM网络则保持固定.

blocks.en: The representation combines dense depth injection with joint-associated geometric aggregation. The depth encoder processes normalized log depth, validity, and spatial gradients to preserve local surface layout, while absolute-depth statistics retain metric context. Depth features are aligned with the RGB feature map and injected through a spatially gated residual: F R ​ D = F I + sigmoid ⁡ ( a + g ⁡ ( GN ⁡ ( F D ) ) ) ⊙ GN ⁡ ( F D ) , F^{RD}=F^{I}+\operatorname{sigmoid}\big(a+g(\operatorname{GN}(F^{D}))\big)\odot\operatorname{GN}(F^{D}), (1) where g g is a learned projection, a a a learned bias, and GN denotes group normalization. Temporal MANO uses F R ​ D F^{RD} to predict coarse orientation, articulation, camera translation, and shared shape. The fused map also supplies the multi-scale evidence for topology-aware sampling in Sec. 3.3 . blocks.en: Direct framewise regression lacks a unified temporal update when local evidence is biased or partially occluded. Building on flow matching and its use for generative hand recovery ( Lipman et al., 2023 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) , we map a two-hand window to motion tokens with component, time, and hand identities. Rotations use continuous 6D coordinates ( Zhou et al., 2019 ) , translation is normalized, and shape is shared within the window. The velocity field v ϕ ​ ( x τ , τ , C n ) v_{\phi}(x_{\tau},\tau,C_{n}) transports Gaussian noise toward the joint state distribution, with the coarse estimate supplied through C n C_{n} rather than used as the initial sample.

DiT-style blocks ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) couple motion tokens across state components, time, and hands through self-attention, and retrieve C n C_{n} through cross-attention. Flow time τ \tau and pooled context C ¯ n \bar{C}_{n} modulate normalization and residual gates. Every velocity evaluation reads C n C_{n} : depth guides placement, while joint-associated HOI and memory features guide articulation and temporal consistency.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We follow the observed-track evaluation convention of HaWoR ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) and compare methods on the same valid observed frames of HOT3D and ARCTIC ( Banerjee et al., 2025 ; Fan et al., 2023 ) , both captured with moving egocentric cameras.
blocks.zh: 我们遵循HaWOR(张等人,2025年)的观测轨道评估公约,并比较HOT3D和ARCTIC(Banerjee等人,2025年;Fan等人,2023年)同一有效观测框架上的方法,两者都用移动的自我中心摄像机捕获。

blocks.en: We report camera MPJPE and absolute world MPJPE (ABS-W-MPJPE) for joint localization. WristErr is the Euclidean error of the single physical wrist point in camera coordinates. RA-MPJPE subtracts the wrist, whereas PA-MPJPE fits a per-frame similarity transform. World W-MPJPE and WA-MPJPE use blockwise similarity alignment fitted to the first two frames or the full block, respectively ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Position errors are in millimetres. World acceleration error, in m/s 2 , measures disagreement with ground-truth joint dynamics on the original timeline. The world reference is established by rigid camera alignment, with no further hand alignment for ABS-W-MPJPE.
blocks.zh: 我们报告相机MPJPE和绝对世界MPJPE(ABS-W-MPJPE)用于联合本地化. 手腕 Err是相机坐标中单个物理腕点的欧几利得误差. RA-MPJPE减去手腕,而PA-MPJPE符合每帧相似性变换. World W-MPJPE和WA-MPJPE分别使用与前两帧或整块相适应的区块相似性(Zhang等人,2025年)。 位置错误为毫米。 世界加速误差以m/s 2表示,测量与原始时间线上的地面-真实联合动态不一致. 世界参考通过僵硬的相机对齐建立,对ABS-W-MPJPE没有进一步的手对齐.

blocks.en: 4.2 Comparison with State of the Art
blocks.zh: 4.2 与艺术状况的比较

blocks.en: We compare against SLAM-lifted HaMeR, WiLoR, and HMP ( Pavlakos et al., 2024 ; Potamias et al., 2025 ; Duran et al., 2024 ) , and video-based methods including Dyn-HaMR, HaWoR, HandFlow, ACE-Ego-Hand, and MINT ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) . Dyn-HaMR retains its native optimized world trajectory.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了SLAM-lifted HaMeR、WiLOR和HMP(Pavlakos等人,2024年;Potamias等人,2025年;Duran等人,2024年)和视频方法,包括Dyn-HAMR、HAWOR、HandFlow、ACE-Ego-Hand和MINT(Yu等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2025年;Xu等人,2026年;Liu等人,2026年;Zhu等人,2026年)。 Dyn-HAMR保留其本土优化的世界轨迹.

blocks.en: Table 1 shows that MetricHand achieves the lowest absolute joint and wrist localization errors among the reevaluated methods on both datasets. We analyze the results in terms of metric localization, pose accuracy, and temporal consistency.
blocks.zh: 表1显示,MetricHand在两个数据集的重新评价方法中实现了最小的绝对关节和腕部定位错误. 我们从度量本地化的角度分析结果,呈现出准确性和时间一致性。

blocks.en: For metric localization , ABS-W-MPJPE reaches 20.58 and 120.86 mm on HOT3D and ARCTIC, reducing HaWoR’s errors by 28.7% and 21.7%, respectively. Wrist localization error also decreases by 48.5% and 37.9%, indicating more accurate physical placement of the reconstructed hands.
blocks.zh: 在计量本地化方面,ABS-W-MPJPE在HOT3D和ARCTIC上分别达到20.58毫米和120.86毫米,将HaWOR的错误分别减少28.7%和21.7%。 手腕本地化误差也减少了48.5%和37.9%,表明重建后的手体位置更准确.

blocks.en: For pose accuracy , PA-MPJPE is 3.18 and 5.18 mm on the two datasets, the lowest values in the tables. Camera-space MPJPE reaches 8.60 and 17.54 mm, showing improvements in both similarity-aligned pose and absolute hand geometry.
blocks.zh: 就姿势精确性而言,PA-MPJPE在两个数据集上分别为3.18毫米和5.18毫米,是表中的最低值。 相机空间MPJPE达到8.60和17.54毫米,显示在相似度对齐姿势和绝对手几何上都有改进.

blocks.en: For temporal consistency , world-space acceleration error is 3.11 and 4.39 m/s 2 , improving over HaWoR by 44.2% and 64.3%, respectively. These results show closer agreement with ground-truth motion dynamics alongside improved localization.
blocks.zh: 就时间一致性而言,世界空间加速误差为3.11米/秒4.39米/秒2,比HaWorR分别提高了44.2%和64.3%. 这些结果表明,在改进本地化的同时,更接近于地面真实运动动态。

Read the RGB frames from top to bottom, then follow the overlaid hand states from translucent early poses to opaque late poses. Each method is shown from the same view with green GT meshes overlaid. MetricHand follows the changing palm orientation and finger configuration in both examples. In HOT3D, its palm and finger contours remain close to GT as the hands move around the object; in ARCTIC, it preserves the transition between open and flexed fingers. These examples illustrate the articulated geometry recovered by the RGB-D-conditioned flow.

blocks.en: Our RGB-D baselines concatenate image and depth features or fuse them through cross-attention before direct regression. On ARCTIC, these reduce RGB-only MPJPE from 36.34 to 31.65 and 29.64 mm. Topology-aware sampling associates HOI geometry with hand joints and reaches 19.98 mm, improving on the two fusion baselines by 36.9% and 32.6%. In the full-model ablation, removing topology-aware sampling raises MPJPE from 17.54 to 38.91 mm. Both comparisons support the value of structured geometric conditions.
blocks.zh: 我们的RGB-D基线将图像和深度特征连接起来,或在直接回归之前通过交叉注意来将其引信。 在ARCTIC上,这些将只使用RGB的MPJPE从36.34减少到31.65和29.64毫米. 地形学-认知采样将HOI几何学与手关节结合,达到19.98毫米,两个聚变基线提高了36.9%和32.6%. 在全模型的衰减中,移除地貌意识的采样将MPJPE从17.54毫米提高到38.91毫米. 这两种比较都支持结构几何条件的价值.

blocks.en: Replacing flow with direct regression retains all conditions, the queue, and the window length. Flow reduces ARCTIC MPJPE from 19.98 to 17.54 mm (12.2%) and acceleration error from 7.93 to 4.39 m/s 2 (44.6%). HOT3D shows the same trend. Flow therefore improves pose accuracy and agreement with ground-truth dynamics under the same geometric conditions.
blocks.zh: 以直接回归取代流保留所有条件,队列和窗口长度. 流量将ARCTIC MPJPE从19.98毫米减少到17.54毫米(12.2%),加速度误差从7.93米/秒减少到4.39米/秒2(44.6%). HOT3D显示出同样的趋势. 因此,在同样的几何条件下,流量会提高准确度并符合地面真实动态。

blocks.en: Removing history raises MPJPE from 8.60 to 15.42 mm on HOT3D and from 17.54 to 25.67 mm on ARCTIC. ARCTIC acceleration error also rises from 4.39 to 6.31 m/s 2 , showing that cross-window context improves both reconstruction and temporal consistency.
blocks.zh: 清除历史使MPJPE在HOT3D上从8.60毫米提高到15.42毫米,在ARCTIC上从17.54毫米提高到25.67毫米. ACTIC加速误差也从4.39米/秒6.31米/秒上升至2. 显示跨窗口环境既改善了重建,也改善了时间一致性.

blocks.en: On ARCTIC, removing regional HOI context or quality weighting raises MPJPE to 32.42 or 25.35 mm, while PA-MPJPE changes from 5.18 to 5.49 or 5.40 mm. Their larger effects on unaligned error indicate a stronger contribution to metric placement than to similarity-aligned pose. Every component removal worsens all reported metrics on both datasets.
blocks.zh: 在ARCTIC上,移除区域HOI上下文或质量权重将MPJPE提高到32.42或25.35毫米,而PA-MPJPE则从5.18变为5.49或5.40毫米. 它们对不结盟错误的较大影响表明,与相似性相适应的姿势相比,对衡量位置的贡献更大。 每个组件的去除都会使两个数据集上报告的所有计量值恶化。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusions and Limitations
blocks.zh: 5. 结论和限制

blocks.en: Conclusion. We presented MetricHand , a geometry-aware flow matching framework for reconstructing 4D hand motion in metric world space. Our key insight is to use hand–object interaction geometry as a shared condition for metric localization and occlusion-robust pose estimation. HOI depth and visual features guide coarse metric estimation and form joint-associated conditions that retain spatial structure and metric scale. Quality-aware conditioning and temporal memory maintain this evidence throughout flow generation, jointly recovering world-space translation, global orientation, articulation, and shape. Experiments on HOT3D and ARCTIC demonstrate improved absolute localization and temporal fidelity. These results highlight the value of persistent geometric conditioning for accurate and temporally coherent hand reconstruction from egocentric video.
blocks.zh: 结论。 我们提出了MetricHand, 一个几何感知流比对框架, 重建4D 手动在公尺世界空间。 我们的关键洞察力是使用手-对象相互作用几何来作为测量本地化和隐形-活性化的共同条件。 HOI的深度和视觉特征指导粗细的度量衡估计,并形成保留空间结构和度量尺度的联动条件. 质量感知条件和时间记忆在整个流程生成过程中保持这些证据,共同恢复世界空间翻译、全球定向、表达和形状。 HOT3D和ARCTIC的实验表明,绝对本地化和时间忠贞性得到了改进。 这些结果凸显出持续的几何条件对于从以自我为中心的视频中进行准确和时间连贯的手部重建的价值.

blocks.en: Limitations. World-space accuracy remains dependent on the estimated camera trajectory and monocular depth prior. Errors in DROID-SLAM rotation, translation, or recovered metric scale propagate to the reconstructed hands and can produce substantial world-space offsets even when camera-space pose is accurate. On ARCTIC, camera MPJPE is 17.54 mm, whereas absolute world MPJPE remains 120.86 mm. MetricHand achieves lower absolute world error than the compared baselines, including those using the shared metric-scaled DROID trajectory. Improving camera motion and depth estimation remains necessary for more accurate global hand placement.
blocks.zh: 限制。 世界空间的精确度仍然取决于相机的估计轨迹和先前的单极深度。 DROID-SLAM 旋转、翻译或恢复的度量尺度的错误向重建的手传播,即使照相机-空间姿势准确,也能产生大量的世界空间抵消。 在ARCTIC上,相机MPJPE为17.54毫米,而绝对世界MPJPE仍然是120.86毫米. MetricHand实现的绝对世界误差低于比较基线,包括使用共享的公尺级DROID轨迹的误差. 改进照相机运动和深度估计对于更准确的全球手位置仍然是必要的。
